novel_features.name: Price Drift Detector
novel_features.description: Flags properties where pricing moved beyond a threshold since your last sync
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining current bulk-availability API response against local SQLite price history — no API endpoint returns price deltas
novel_features.why_it_matters: When monitoring property pricing for affiliate content or OTA inventory, this command replaces manual spreadsheet comparison with a single query

novel_features.name: Review Category Ranker
novel_features.description: Ranks properties by user-specified review sub-categories (cleanliness, location, staff) with price filtering
novel_features.rationale: Joins review_scores + accommodations + availability tables locally — no API endpoint filters across properties by review category thresholds
novel_features.why_it_matters: When curating top-N property lists for content or recommendations, this replaces hours of manual web browsing with a structured query

novel_features.name: Upcoming Orders Dashboard
novel_features.description: Lists orders with imminent check-in dates, highlighting those with unresolved message threads
novel_features.rationale: Joins orders filtered by check-in date with message resolution status — no single API endpoint combines order timeline with messaging state
novel_features.why_it_matters: When managing active bookings, this single command replaces toggling between orders and messages screens

novel_features.name: Property Change Digest
novel_features.description: Shows field-level diffs for properties that changed since your last sync
novel_features.rationale: Calls the changes endpoint for IDs, then diffs against locally stored details to produce per-field changelogs
novel_features.why_it_matters: When maintaining an OTA inventory, this command catches price and facility changes that would otherwise require manual API polling

novel_features.name: Facility Comparison Matrix
novel_features.description: Side-by-side comparison of multiple properties across facilities, review scores, and pricing
novel_features.rationale: Joins accommodations + facilities + review_scores + availability for N properties — no API endpoint returns cross-property comparisons
novel_features.why_it_matters: When narrowing down property options for a client or article, this replaces manual tab-switching with a structured diff

novel_features.name: Destination Intelligence
novel_features.description: City-level analytics: property count, average scores, price ranges, top landmarks, district breakdown
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates 6 local tables (cities, districts, landmarks, accommodations, review_scores, availability) — no API endpoint provides city-level analytics
novel_features.why_it_matters: When researching a new destination for content or travel planning, this produces a data-driven overview that replaces hours of browsing

narrative.headline: Every Booking.com Demand API feature, plus offline search, price drift detection, and review-based property ranking that no other tool offers
narrative.value_prop: The only CLI for Booking.com's Demand API. Search accommodations, manage bookings, track price changes, and rank properties by review categories — all with offline SQLite storage, agent-native JSON output, and full MCP server support.
narrative.auth_narrative: Requires a Booking.com Demand API Bearer token and Affiliate ID. Get partner access at developers.booking.com. Set BOOKING_API_TOKEN and BOOKING_AFFILIATE_ID in your environment.

quickstart.comment: Configure your Bearer token and Affiliate ID
Populate the local store for offline queries
Rank by review quality and price

troubleshoots.fix: Verify your Bearer token is set: booking-com-demand-pp-cli doctor --json
Check your Affiliate ID is correct and your partner account has Demand API access enabled
The CLI uses adaptive rate limiting. Wait 60 seconds or reduce --limit on bulk operations
Verify date range is in the future and destination exists: booking-com-demand-pp-cli locations cities --query Amsterdam

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you need programmatic access to Booking.com's accommodation search, booking management, or property data. Ideal for travel affiliates automating content creation, OTA engineers syncing inventory, and travel agents managing bookings. The offline store and review ranking make it particularly valuable for recurring workflows like weekly price monitoring or destination research.
